hypothesis: A local PCM energy-rise measurement can refine the timing of a fixed learned musical anchor below its 20-ms feature lattice without changing event selection, metrical level, context length or the existing OLS projection.

inputs.audio: same hash-bound 48-kHz stereo PCM16 canonical WAVs, read only their original requested <=30-second prefixes; hash full WAVs before/after

algorithm.name: fixed-anchor-stereo-energy-rise-v1
algorithm.evidence: int64 stereo sum of squared PCM16 samples per source frame; at candidate c use left=[c-96,c), right=[c,c+96), positive contrast=right_energy-left_energy; do not sum stereo channels before squaring
algorithm.search: exactly 41 positions anchor+k*48, k=-20..20; require complete [anchor-1056,anchor+1056) source PCM with no declared unavailable-input intersection; no zero padding, resampling or delay compensation
algorithm.peak: earliest maximal positive contrast; require combined energy >=2*96*2*64^2, 4*contrast>=combined_energy, and contrast>=2*largest_positive_competitor farther than 96 frames from the winner; zero competitor is allowed; equal peaks outside the exclusion radius are ambiguous
algorithm.boundaries: winning search-edge positions are unsupported; winner must stay in the original S6 window and strictly in the original event's midpoint ownership cell; otherwise retain original anchor and report why
algorithm.no_attack_or_ambiguity: retain the original musical anchor unchanged with an explicit unrefined reason, never call it precise attack support; do not drop the event, choose a weaker peak or change thresholds
algorithm.known_pcm_gap: retain original coordinate with unavailable-input status and abstain from any affected window's projection; unavailable data is never silence; an absent musical attack is not a PCM gap
algorithm.projection: unchanged apta_1_1_neural_reference.project applied to refined events on the same six S6 windows; keep original event count/order/window membership and original downbeat event indices; no four-neighbor fit, longer context, metrical-level search or baseline/candidate score oracle
algorithm.meter: unchanged two-complete-equal-bars support and same-grid projected downbeat rule, using original downbeat event indices mapped onto refined coordinates
algorithm.confidence: uncalibrated placeholder zero; provisional host diagnostic only

evaluation.stage_a: one fixed GTZAN development cohort in original manifest order; all 600 windows retained; score against unchanged OLS and coarse with the frozen constant-grid scorer plus unchanged common/one-to-one diagnostics; inspect aggregate veto after the complete cohort only
evaluation.coarse_regressions: no new coarse joint-break identities beyond the two already broken by the unchanged OLS baseline; report both old regressions individually; retaining them still forbids production promotion
evaluation.anchor_diagnostics: counts/reasons/movement, raw versus refined common phase/period diagnostics and point phase fixes/breaks; these never replace the old projection scorer or alter a candidate coordinate
evaluation.failure_action: reject this exact PCM candidate and stop before transfer; no radius, contrast, dominance, fallback, context or model rescue on this cohort
evaluation.identity_or_control_mismatch: stop immediately, preserve failed attempt, no accuracy conclusion

reserved_transfer.stage: B; only after every stage-A development gate passes; fixed algorithm, no retuning
reserved_transfer.dataset: existing forty ASAP development-only rendered performances, 240 windows; formal ASAP holdout stays closed
reserved_transfer.inference: same fixed Beat This final0 checkpoint and source-coordinate decoder, no BeatNet or model search; separately freeze runtime/audio/events/control artifacts before any transfer scores
reserved_transfer.gates: strict joint and complete-sequence improvement over newly frozen same-source Beat This OLS control; zero period/phase/joint/meter/downbeat breaks; no new coarse joint-break identities; every source/window retained
reserved_transfer.evidence_level: untouched by this PCM candidate, but previously used native development inputs; no claim of fresh product acceptance or verified training-set nonoverlap
reserved_transfer.on_stage_a_failure: do not load transfer labels/audio or run inference

resources.expected_cost: one <=30-second int64 stereo-energy prefix array plus 41 two-window sums per anchor; one source in memory at a time
